title: Adding and verifying contacts
summary: This document explains how to add and verify contacts in Everyone Pay: use “Add Contact,” enter a username/email/mobile, confirm display details, and note you can save up to $550 contacts. It also covers contact verification before the first transaction (open profile and follow prompts) and managing contacts via edit/remove and search/filters.
